parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented birth-sex facility or border rule, and an anti-discrimination law that names transgender status. Against this, the dossier documents tier-2/3 exposure with weak recourse: an open police-abuse probe with no sanction, a custody recommendation that trans women be searched by male or combined staff unless they choose a female officer, more than 20 unsanctioned attacks on an LGBT centre, a hate-crime law with one conviction since 2012, and rule-of-law weaknesses noted by an international report. Hostile attitudes are substantial (57% see homosexuality as a disease; 70 politicians' hate-speech instances). Resident-facing items (job fears, medical responsiveness, surgery coverage) carry little weight. Enforcement is weak but not documented as targeting visitors, and the custody exposure is a single recommendation for the capital, so I place this in the elevated band.
